timeline.body:
This PR add a `ReferenceCountedChannelPool` which will create `poolSize` number of channels and round-robin across them for gRPC requests.

The `poolSize` is calculated as `jobs / 100`.

Fixes #11801.
yeah, this is my main question: How did you come up with this number?

reply.body: I believe its based on the recommendation here - https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/11801#issuecomment-672973245
That makes sense indeed. Chi, can you please document this in the code?

Note that the recommendation there is to either take into account the number of IPs (the number of connections, aka subchannels, per channel), or to assume 2 IPs per host which would be jobs/100 "Channels" in this pool.

Looking at this code, just assuming 2 makes more sense to me than having to also reimplement the subchannel->channel interface, which I think would be required to count the IPs. So I vote for simply changing this constant to 100 and documenting clearly why it is what it is.
